name: Outer Range
description: A rancher fighting for his land and family stumbles upon an unfathomable mystery at the edge of Wyoming’s wilderness, forcing a confrontation with the Unknown in ways both intimate and cosmic in the untamable American West.

videos.title: The Void
videos.overview: Wyoming rancher Royal Abbott discovers an unfathomable mystery at the edge of his property, setting in motion a catastrophic chain of events.

videos.title: The Land
videos.overview: The Abbott family frantically conspires to cover up their crimes but can’t piece together what has happened to Royal.

videos.title: The Time
videos.overview: The investigation for the missing Tillerson brother forces Royal to ally with Autumn, until Amy makes an improbable discovery.

videos.title: The Loss
videos.overview: As word spreads about the Tillerson murder, Sheriff Joy interrogates the Abbotts, forcing Royal to wager far more than he can afford to lose.

videos.title: The Soil
videos.overview: Royal embarks on a quest to investigate the elusive dark mineral that is present on his land, only to intensify his growing rivalry with Autumn.

videos.title: The Family
videos.overview: With family ties beginning to fray, Royal takes violent measures to get rid of Autumn, but is foiled when he discovers she has manipulated someone close to him.

videos.title: The Unknown
videos.overview: As the Tillersons close in on the Abbott’s secrets, Royal must salvage what is left of his family and livelihood. Autumn orchestrates the unthinkable.

videos.title: The West
videos.overview: The Abbott family faces a grand reckoning over the course of a single day as the showdown between Royal and Autumn culminates, unearthing a shattering revelation.

videos.title: One Night in Wabang
videos.overview: In the aftermath of the bison stampede, the Abbott family is more fractured than ever. Royal and Cecilia confront some difficult truths as they fight to keep their family together.

videos.title: Traces to Somewhere
videos.overview: Perry seeks help from an unexpected family member. The Tillersons promise revenge against the Abbotts, while Royal contends with a new threat to the West Pasture.

videos.title: Everybody Hurts
videos.overview: Royal and Cecelia become desperate in their attempt to save their ranch. The Tillerson’s are dealt with a startling turn of events.

videos.title: Ode to Joy
videos.overview: Lost in time with no way home, Sheriff Joy must navigate a new life among her Shoshone ancestors.

videos.title: All the World's a Stage
videos.overview: Royal rediscovers an unlikely ally; Cecilia grapples with the possibility of Autumn’s identity as Autumn becomes increasingly unhinged.

videos.title: Do-Si-Do
videos.overview: Autumn’s erratic behavior reaches a fever pitch. Royal and Cecilia take matters into their own hands.
